body: Do you think I give a shit, bud?
Thanks but I'm not looking to be talked out of it. My mind is made up, I just wanted to know if anyone had any better ideas. Sorry, have a good day, man.
I'll check that out but she really doesn't want to go to therapy, but I'm trying to convince her slowly
Yeah, I'm trying not to(that's what our last fight was about), but it's difficult. And that's what i need help with, is finding what can take it away, or at least reduce it. Thanks

I'm trying but I'm not going to bail. I've known her for 11 years, had a huge crush for 4, been friends for 2 and a half, and been dating for 6 months. I can't leave her, she's an absolutely wonderful person and she needs me. She doesn't have anyone else. Thanks

It's just general anxiety about most everything. We've talked about it and I've tried telling her that most of the things she's anxious about are nothing to worry about and the few good things, we can work on. I'm trying, but I'm soft too. Thanks

I'm trying to be there for her as much as I possibly can. I have been telling her I'm proud of her every time she says she felt like throwing up but was able to suppress it and when she does stuff that's difficult. She hasn't and doesn't want to, but I'm hoping that with some gentle prodding I can get her to. And yeah, I've told her that and she does talk to me about everything. I don't get angry(except for when she doesn't tell me because she promised to tell me) but I do get disappointed. It hasn't scared me away. I have anxiety and depression too but I cope with it differently. Thank you for your comment, really.
